entries.name: AddChild
entries.summary: Places a child in a grid cell.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to place.

params.name: row
params.text: The row index.

params.name: column
params.text: The column index.

params.name: rowSpan
params.text: How many rows the child should cover.

params.name: columnSpan
params.text: How many columns the child should cover.

entries.name: AddColumn
entries.summary: Adds a column definition to the grid.

params.name: mode
params.text: Whether the column should size to its contents, use a fixed pixel value, or share leftover space.

params.name: value
params.text: The pixel size for Fixed columns or the weight for Star columns. Auto columns ignore this.

entries.name: AddColumns
entries.summary: Adds several column definitions at once.

params.name: defs
params.text: The columns to add, in order.

entries.name: AddRow
entries.summary: Adds a row definition to the grid.

params.name: mode
params.text: Controls row sizing: Auto (fits content), Fixed (pixel value), or Star (distributes remaining space).

params.name: value
params.text: The pixel size for Fixed rows or the weight for Star rows. Auto rows ignore this.

entries.name: AddRows
entries.summary: Adds several row definitions at once.

params.name: defs
params.text: The rows to add, in order.

entries.name: Arrange
entries.summary: Positions each child inside its assigned cell.

params.name: finalWidth
params.text: The width assigned to the grid.

params.name: finalHeight
params.text: The height assigned to the grid.

entries.name: Definition
entries.summary: Holds sizing information for a grid row or column.

entries.name: GetColumn
entries.summary: Gets the column assigned to a child.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to inspect.

entries.name: GetColumnSpan
entries.summary: Gets the column span for a child.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to inspect.

entries.name: GetRow
entries.summary: Gets the row assigned to a child.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to inspect.

entries.name: GetRowSpan
entries.summary: Gets the row span for a child.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to inspect.

entries.name: Grid
entries.summary: Lays out children in a grid of rows and columns.
entries.details: Rows and columns must be added before children can be placed. Row and column indices are zero-based.

entries.name: Measure
entries.summary: Measures the grid and resolves Auto-sized rows and columns.

params.name: availableWidth
params.text: The width available to the grid.

params.name: availableHeight
params.text: The height available to the grid.

entries.name: SetColumn
entries.summary: Sets the column for a child.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to update.

params.name: column
params.text: The column index.

entries.name: SetColumnSpan
entries.summary: Sets how many columns the child should span.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to update.

params.name: span
params.text: The number of columns the child should cover.

entries.name: SetRow
entries.summary: Sets the row for a child.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to update.

params.name: row
params.text: The row index.

entries.name: SetRowSpan
entries.summary: Sets how many rows the child should span.

params.name: child
params.text: The child to update.

params.name: span
params.text: The number of rows the child should cover.

entries.name: SizeMode
entries.summary: Defines how a row or column should size itself.
entries.details: Auto lets the row or column fit its contents, Fixed uses the value you give it, and Star takes the remaining space.
